## What's fixed

- **Holding a widget on Home does something now.** In 2.0.0 a widget took the touch itself (to open the player, start a station and so on), so holding one to edit never got through. Now holding a widget opens a menu, like on the iPhone's home screen. **Edit widgets** makes them wiggle: the minus takes one away, dragging one onto another moves it, and Add a widget offers the rest. **Size**, **Add a widget** and **Remove widget** work from the menu directly.

## What's new

- **Widgets in Settings.** Settings → Home page has a Widgets section at the top. Switch widgets off altogether, or add, remove, move and resize them there.

## Install

Download **Kultr.ipa** below and install it with **Sideloadly** (Windows, Mac), **AltStore** (Windows, Mac), **Feather** or **Impactor** (Linux) — or with no computer at all, through **SideStore** installed by **SideInstaller** (only from sideinstaller.net) with **LocalDevVPN** connected. Or add the source `https://gist.githubusercontent.com/evropiani/6e3a3c18525a228d03924674430c4d48/raw/evropiani.json` in SideStore and update from there.

Installing over an earlier version keeps your servers, library, listening history, analysis and downloads — install it with the same Apple ID and don't delete the old app first.
